name: Iris's Overrides, Tweaks, Emote wheel and armor
description: Everything in one mod: client-side skin overrides, a movable HUD (armor, effects, minimap, keystrokes, clock...), map and waypoints, chat colors / emotes / heads, freecam, chest sorter, Weapon Master, profiles, capes, a villager trade reroller and more, plus the Emote Wheel with 310+ emotes and the Hinata / maid armor outfits (nested inside this jar). Install it on the server too if you want other players to see your emotes.
